name: Pertuzumab
mechanism: Humanised IgG1 binding HER2 domain II, blocking ligand-dependent HER2 heterodimerisation, particularly with HER3. Complements trastuzumab for dual HER2 blockade. A fixed-dose subcutaneous combination with trastuzumab is available.
resistance: Shares resistance mechanisms with trastuzumab, including PI3K pathway activation.
